_comment: Pure-synthetic counterparts of the mfc2_syn_* scenarios (data_source='synthetic': the pipeline generates its own ground truth).

Unlike ensemble_scenarios_synthetic_mfc2.json (mirror dataset loaded through the real-data path, no truth), Step 6 here also writes the truth, RMSE and MAE maps (water_content_{xz,xy}_*_{truth,rmse,mae}.png).
Not read by tests/test_pipeline_mfc2_synthetic.py. Run with: ./run_one_scenario.sh -s mfc2_syn_free1_synthetic -c ensemble_scenarios_synthetic_truth.json --mode 2d [--quick]

mfc2_syn_free1_synthetic.description: mfc2_syn_free1 (pooled WS, K=1 free parameter sigma_s) run through the pure-synthetic path, own ground truth.
